title: Health Resort east wing room 314 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 314 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 314 key (E314 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 314.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 313 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - At the "checkpoint" on the eastern side of the map, in a cabin on a wooden stool.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 314 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 314:
  - 1× Weapon box (6x2)
  - 1× Weapon Spawn
  - Loose Loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Weapon mods, Currency)
- Room 313:
  - 1x LEDX spawn
  - 1× Weapon box (6x4)
  - 1× Medbag
  - Loose Loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Weapon mods, Currency)
